title: fix(news): skip model and API checks for master PR gists
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The news gist now checks model and API changes only for PRs merged into main. Master has an unrelated shared/ directory and APIDOCS.md, so those files no longer trigger a comparison against main’s model catalog. Master PRs can still produce their normal gist and Discord post; a test covers a master PR touching both paths. The fix is intended to allow gists for #17296, #17333, and #17355 to be rerun.
